decisive_items: dermal infiltrate of atypical lymphocytes, which were CD20+, CD79a+, and CD5+
PCR analysis revealed a clonal IgH gene rearrangement
PET-CT scan demonstrated FDG-avid abdominal and peripancreatic lymph nodes
response.rationale: The B-cell immunophenotype with clonal IgH rearrangement confirms a B-cell lymphoma, and the systemic PET-CT findings favor diffuse large B-cell lymphoma over a localized primary cutaneous subtype.

rejected.why: Clonal IgH rearrangement and CD20/CD79a positivity indicate B-cell lineage, not NK/T-cell lymphoma.
No features of lymphomatoid granulomatosis such as angiocentricity or pulmonary predominance; B-cell immunophenotype and clonal IgH support DLBCL.
Leg-type primary cutaneous DLBCL is not supported by penile location and systemic nodal involvement.
Cutaneous T-cell lymphoma is contradicted by CD20+, CD79a+, and clonal IgH rearrangement.
